name: word-roller-slot-reveal
title: Word Roller Slot Reveal
description: A list of ten words scrolls through a masked window beside a fixed prefix: slow start, a fast stretch, then a very long, gentle slowdown onto the last word, which lands larger in the accent colour.
useWhen: A reveal where a long list of options spins past and settles on one chosen word (new feature, new future).
A product or campaign name that should be the payoff of a spin.
avoidWhen: Only two or three words: use inline-word-roll.
The final word should not be emphasised: it is always larger and in the accent colour.
author: lifeprompt-team

variables.label: Words
variables.description: Words in order, separated by commas (up to 14). The last one is where it settles.
variables.default: Feature, Product, Design, Service, Solution, Platform, Experience, Vision, Future, Beginning

variables.label: Font size
variables.description: Size of the rolling words in pixels. A wide line shrinks to fit the frame.

variables.label: Word color
variables.description: Color of the words while they roll.

variables.label: Background
variables.description: Fill behind the text. Use transparent to lay the block over your own footage.
